features: Separate phone Internet, local board and public board presence with 30-second evidence expiry.
Pinned SSH authentication confirms board presence; public TCP/TLS alone never implies the board is online.
Background probes own independent sockets, run only while foreground and control idle, and never execute remote commands.
Active control uses existing ACKs; heartbeat periods, deadlines, stop rules and motor settings are unchanged.
Explicit public-route recovery preserves first faults and pending control locks, then reuses read-only ownership inspection.
Local wireless confirmation does not block public profile import or connection; it is not silently cleared.

validation.manualPageVisualCheck: All controls remain visible without vertical scrolling.

incident.rootCauseLimit: Initial packet/transport/scheduling delay is unresolved; earlier Wi-Fi roaming is a lead, not proven causation. Device clocks were not calibrated.
